name: star_eye
description: a luminous blue eye on near-black: a Julia set's ring glowing pale blue round a dark pupil holding a star, fine field-line strands curving out of the ring and in to the star, faint equipotential rings beyond

reference.made_with: a flame fractal (Apophysis-style, signed Kerti Alev '07), 1920x1200

reuses: a falloff glow on de 3e-2 of the frame wide from the map's middle, over a quarter-strength fog of the inverted distance estimate through the map by rank at gamma 4: the luminous ring hugging a quasicircle Julia set (the rank fog alone always spends the map's top on the frame's nearest tenth, and held p90 over the band)
field_lines' lines channel on both sides, its angle cut by a period sheet with a twist: fine strands curving out of the ring, and inside, a pinwheel that draws a star round the attracting fixed point
field smooth as a thin period sheet: faint equipotential rings beyond

glow_filaments' falloff glows on de, softened: no hair-wide near-white add core, the innermost glow 4e-4 wide and screened from the map's middle, so dense lace stops at a mid tone instead of flooding white
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Added: nothing: a falloff ring, the `lines` channel on both sides for the strands and the pupil's star. Its structure, quasicircle Julia sets, is one the galleries lack: its locations are hand-placed (step 4's exception)
Lessons: came in one item with teal_filaments; its notes hold them.
